topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling may compromise link budgets by allocating insufficient resources, potentially leading to congestion and QoS violations.
reference_context: Link budgets and QoS provisioning are crucial in converged satellite and terrestrial networks, considering factors like capacity, latency, and jitter.
